//: Type-checking only — no emit, no build step. The server (src/**/*.ts)
is TypeScript run natively by Node's type stripping (entry: node
src/index.ts). allowJs/checkJs cover the plain-JS test files —
include lists tests/**/*.js so they really are checked; scripts/,
cli/ and debug/ are TypeScript too, all run via plain node (no tsx).
tsc here is purely a static
checker (`npm run typecheck`). Strictness is deliberately moderate:
the goal is catching the mistakes that actually bit this project
(reading a config field that does not exist — see issue #49 — wrong
argument counts, typos on typed objects).
